# RZN Dental Care

> RZN Dental Care is a comprehensive dental practice in Michigan offering general, cosmetic, emergency, and pediatric dentistry services across multiple locations.

Led by Dr. Regina Nrekaj, RZN Dental Care serves patients in Farmington Hills, Livonia, Novi, Northville, and Plymouth with a focus on family dentistry, emergency care, and modern treatments like Invisalign. The practice emphasizes preventive care, digital radiology, and emergency dental services for the Oakland and Wayne County areas.
